 Ryan Garcia Slaps Streamer Kanel Joseph's Camera At Halloween Party
 Ryan Garcia 
 Slaps Streamer Kanel Joseph's Cam 
 Fresh One For Security, Too! 
 Add TMZ on Google 
 By TMZ Staff 
 Published 
 October 30, 2026
 10:09 AM PDT 
 Play video content 
 SPOOKY SMACKDOWN 
 Video: Ryan Garcia Slaps Streamer Kanel Joseph's Camera At Halloween Party 
 KICK/kaneljoseph 
 Ryan Garcia had ONE rule for streamer Kanel Joseph at his private Halloween party -- put the camera away -- so when Kanel kept rolling, KingRy wasn't having it ... and hands started flying!
 And yes, the whole thing was streamed live.
 Garcia and N3ON co-hosted a costume party in L.A. on Thursday, and the story goes that outside streams weren't allowed because the guys had sponsorship deals that prohibited others from streaming.
 Getty 
 So, the champion boxer and party host walked up to Kanel and told him to stop recording. When the stream kept going, Garcia reached over and slapped the camera to the ground.
 But that wasn't the end of the confrontation. Garcia turned to Kanel's security guard and slapped him, too, as party guests watched.
 Joseph eventually got the hint ... but rather than staying, he just bailed on the party.
 KICK/kaneljoseph 
 As for Garcia, he hasn't said anything publicly about the run-in.
 Note to all future party guests... cameras AWAY at Ryan's place!
